omitted_h55_log_edge_transforms.clarification: These bands remain present as raw/pre-existing features in the inherited R2 view/structural-contrast feature sets; the H55-specific signed-LoG and sign-change channels were not computed for them.

measured_result_scope: The reported H55 holdout and full-data raster correspond to the implemented subset (new LoG features on bands 13 and 2, with the registered cover/slope interaction), not the complete transform set described in the frozen H55-1 candidate-feature list.
handling: The original preregistration and result receipts are preserved unchanged; this note does not retroactively amend them. Do not describe the full registered H55-1 transform set as tested. Any future test of the omitted channels must be separately preregistered and evaluated on an untouched confirmation design; do not tune against the already-used four folds.
